notes.title: Workshop Submission Event! Celebration of Your Boss's Butt Resurrection!
notes.content:
To celebrate your boss's butt winning the comeback battle, we're launching a two-month Workshop submission event!

Event Period:
May 13th ~ July 12th

Submission Requirements:
Upload 1 butt-themed image or sound effect to the Workshop!

Judging Criteria:
[olist]
 Awards will be based on the number of positive reviews from players. The more players love your butt, the higher your chances!
 Bonus points if it aligns with my personal tastes (just kidding... or am I?).
[/olist]


Prizes:

 1st Place: Steam Gift Card (60 CNY) ×1
 2nd Place: Steam Gift Card (30 CNY) ×2
 3rd Place: PG's CD-KEY ×7
 


Join the fun and showcase your creativity!
Wishing you all the joy of clocking out on time every day!
That's all! 🍑✨
